name: series-rating-graphs

description: Search for TV show ratings and get individual episode ratings, straight from Raycast
author: muhammadrizo

commands.name: search-shows
commands.title: Search TV Shows
commands.description: Search for TV shows and get episode ratings
commands.subtitle: Series Rating Graphs

tools.name: get-show-details
tools.title: Get TV Show Details
tools.description: Get details about a TV show

ai.instructions:
Provide TV show information and ratings graphs as a Markdown table.

- Always call "search-shows" first for a show name.
- Only call "get-show-details" after obtaining an ID from "search-shows".
- If multiple results are plausible, ask the user to choose using the title, startYear, and endYear in this format: "title (startYear–endYear)".
- Do not invent missing values.
- Preserve ratingsTable exactly as returned by "get-show-details".

How to write the details:
[title]
> [originalTitle] (write this only when it differs from title)

Seasons: [seasonsCount]
Release Date: [startYear]–[endYear]
Rating: [rating.aggregateRating] ([rating.voteCount] votes)

[plot]

[ratingsTable]

get-show-details.title: Daredevil
get-show-details.plot: A blind lawyer by day, vigilante by night. Matt Murdock fights the crime of New York as Daredevil.
get-show-details.ratingsTable:
> 🏆 Awesome | 🟩 Great | 🟨 Good | 🟧 Regular | 🟥 Bad | 🟪 Garbage

| Ep # | S1 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 🟩8.4 |
| 2 | 🟩8.9 |

expected.meetsCriteria: Presents the selected Daredevil show's title, seasons count, release years, aggregate rating, vote count, plot, and the ratingsTable returned by get-show-details without changing it.

evals.input: @series-rating-graphs show me ratings for The Office

expected.meetsCriteria: Explains that multiple shows match and asks the user to choose, listing each result as title (startYear–endYear).

evals.input: @series-rating-graphs I mean The Office US from 2005

get-show-details.title: The Office
get-show-details.plot: A mockumentary on a group of typical office workers, where the workday consists of ego clashes, inappropriate behavior, tedium and romance.

expected.meetsCriteria: Presents the details for the 2005–2013 version of The Office and preserves the ratingsTable exactly.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
